notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 is back - Temporary Maintenance
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I'm dropping by to say to you all that my team and I are completely aware of the many bugs Pact of the Ancients have. To create visual novel moments with full voice-over we implemented a Unity template that we used to work for our novels and we adapted it to support a huge gameplay moment. However, this template didn't work as we planned and basically all bugs and negative reviews we have been receiving are being caused by it. 

We know how to fix that and the answer is quite simple: we are remaking the gameplay! The moments you buy a skill/equipment, the lewd animations you have during the gameplay, the chests that release a portion of the story, and then a CG; EVERYTHING is being remade.

We tried to keep our schedule and bring more content but it's not possible to enjoy it when you find so many bugs. So I decided to return to the last stable version of the game and suspend the updates while we work on a major update to fix everything you've been reporting to us. We hope to release it by December 18th (as I said, we are remaking A LOT OF THINGS) and we hope you understand our situation. This game was a huge step for us and as a small studio with only 1 programmer dedicated to the game, there is not much we can do to speed it up.

Thank you all for your patience and we hope the major update can give us the experience we want to provide you.

Victoria Invicta
CEO of Male Doll Studio

notes.title: Patch 1.2.0 is now available with new scenes!
notes.content:
We're so excited to announce a new update to Pact of the Ancients! Check out what has changed.

3 new SFW collectable scenes, involving 3 couples: 

 Gladiator and Demon(collectable in the Goblin Hideout)
 Gladiator and Barbarian(collectable in the Pirate Island)
 Gladiator and Satyr(collectable in the Viking Village)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41903262/6afad2592a7ee8dd3878efe1b2fa2599c7dc2c87.png
As you saw on the game road map available on the Steam page, we would have 5 but to focus on fixing bugs as soon as possible, we had put our efforts into that and we decided to make scenes involving couples instead of individual scenes. In the next few weeks, the voice-over for these scenes will be implemented. Stay tuned on the patch notes to be notified about that.

Also, after receiving a lot of feedback regarding bugs and freezes, we were able to identify what was causing these problems. However, it will take some time to fix them and a few gameplay adjustments will be necessary in order to have a good performance. We're already working on these improvements and we hope to release a new path by December early. Thank you so much for your patience!

If you find any bugs, feel free to join Discord to report them and/or use the game forum.

Male Doll Team

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 is now available with new modes!
notes.content:
A major patch with a lot of improvements is now available. Check out what has changed:

New Modes have been implemented:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41903262/9aa97e382aaae29fdd84740a6d183adbc3e82a95.png

-Challenge Mode: Doubles enemy spawn rate
-Eternity Mode: Doubles the stage duration
-Shadow Mode: You can't buy new weapons
-Hyperspeed Mode: Increases your and your enemies' speed, and your projectile speed
-Ultra Mode: Massively reduces the cooldown of your skills
-Ancient Mode: You can upgrade skills and equipment beyond their usual limit
-Lunar Mode: Massively increases knockback of your and enemies' attacks
-Merciless Mode: You only have 1 HP
-Treasure Mode: Treasures become common, but you get less XP from each gem
-Gambler Mode: You get +10 rerolls

Also, there is a net Settings screen (it will be presented only with you install the DLC):

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41903262/c71818389ba0642ff09e24b43379d2b935ba43e8.png

Lastly, a few other changes.

-Options to replay the intro scene and the tutorial
-Major and minor bug fixes

That's it! We hope you enjoy it and feel free to report anything you consider relevant.

Male Doll Team

notes.title: Patch Notes Demo 1.2.0
notes.content:
Thanks to all feedback we received, we made some improvements. Check them out!


 Control fixes to match the input directions 
 The skill buy window is now correctly shown when you level up 
 A forfeit option has been added to the Pause menu, making gold and achievements grind more accessible 
 Enemy attack range decreased 
 Minor UI fixes 
 Minor bug fixes Important 

When initializing the new build, press F11 and delete the save files, preventing bugs from happening because of file version differences.

Thank you all for supporting us in this project!

Male Doll Team
